issue_request: FHIR-5645 was Published/Not Persuasive with Modification. It followed up on FHIR-3600 by asking to change ImagingStudy.series.bodySite to CodeableConcept or Reference(BodySite), but the final IIWG resolution rejected BodySite for imaging and instead directed adding ImagingStudy.series.laterality 0..1 Coding mapped from DICOM Laterality (0020,0060) when laterality is not precoordinated in bodySite.
initial_application: The issue was applied historically: git history contains 7c372ff4a15b4c42dd76d82b5f49c6b2298bdaf4, titled 'Update ImagingStudy [5645] [5606] [5551]', changing the old ImagingStudy spreadsheet/example source, and later imported StructureDefinition history carried ImagingStudy.series.laterality forward until R6 removal work.
additional_context: FHIR-3600 is the broader BodySite harmonization parent. FHIR-46301 later added R6 consistency guidance to ImagingStudy.series.laterality, but FHIR-50859 subsequently removed ImagingStudy.series.laterality and clarified representation of laterality through ImagingStudy.series.bodySite as a precoordinated code or BodyStructure reference. FHIR-50859 is already represented on the combined branch by c74110674e00bcf8255ca05b2cc1f4b290cbbb24, and FHIR-50545 recorded no change because laterality was likely to be removed.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current active ImagingStudy source has bodySite as CodeableReference(BodyStructure), includes laterality wording and DICOM Laterality mapping, and the ImagingStudy notes explain coded and BodyStructure laterality representations. No authoritative ImagingStudy.series.laterality source element remains; remaining stale mentions are generated-looking SVG diagram content outside the edit threshold for this seed.
